title: Lift natural overlap comparisons without their cocycle equations
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram of Noetherian rings, c a limit cone of Spec(R) with affine vertex S, and f:X_i→Spec(R_i) a quasi-compact, quasi-separated, locally finitely presented morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions]. For j≥i write X_j=X_i×Spec(R_j) and X=X_i×S [def-pc-base-change]. Fix a finite affine open cover U of X_j and finitely presented quasi-coherent modules N_a on its members [pqf-def-coherent]. Let M be any module on X. Suppose the pullbacks of N_a to the limit cover are isomorphic to the restrictions of M, by specified isomorphisms e_a. There exist k≥j and natural overlap transitions T [def-pc-local-overlap-transitions] on V=U×X_k, with T_a isomorphic to the prescribed pullback of N_a, and an invertible component comparison from the limit pullback of T to the restriction descent data of M. The comparison commutes with all transition maps. No identity or triple cocycle equation is asserted for T at stage k.

source.place: Lemma limits-lemma-descend-modules-finite-presentation, Tag 01ZR, first proof (Zariski gluing); Algebra Tag 05N7

proof.text: For each ordered pair of chart indices, apply single-overlap map lifting with persistence. Choose an upper bound for j and the finite set of resulting stages; persistence supplies all pairwise maps at this common stage. The objects at the stage are the actual pullbacks of the prescribed local models.

At the common stage take the actual pullbacks of N as objects, and use their canonical iterated limit comparisons. Each pairwise lifting theorem supplies a map and a commutative square on its universal limit overlap. Apply universal-overlap transition assembly to this family of maps and squares. It returns natural transitions with exactly those objects and the required comparison on all test schemes. Equality of objects gives the local isomorphisms by eqToIso.
